And, well, these wealthy and noble pirates would trade with various ships, or other pirates, right there on the sea, and their lives were full of adventure and drama and fightin' with sea beasts and giant pentapuses with eight tentacles. So after startin' my business and havin' people avoid me like the plague... I started doin' this thing.<end>
